book.title: Luk Dowan Weng Olo Luke Dolanebuotabe.

content: Maliao Yesuse dobmikisobe.
Am olo dimo Lom bib seli komok sume niniino Sisa Ogastase baanea Bib mak bib mako alukum nakaia unangai niniino oyemabibo gesebe.
I sino kukub olo mo inaim blimobe. Mema olota kukub olo omfanibtabe. Am olo dimo Silia bib seli komoke niniino Sailinias eta kima bia
nakaia unangai alukum i bibamo deiboniba moniba faninwali binibbio bib ye motemoba niniino dolabeine geniba unebiba
eka Yoseb ele Debite molofeit kesoa e Galili betano bibo Nasalet bib ye danea monea Yudia betano e fanine Debite bibo niniino Betlehem bib ye motemano genea
Maliao Yosebe omakabaniba Yosebe alelobo geibbu otane i mo kam keim blimobe. O bekebanoa kam monoba niniino dolabeine geniba onsiobe. I inasibo Maliao amunsa biotabe.
I inaniba moniba Betlehem bib ye bliba mene weme kesoa

o miine hek sume naka ten dofanoa o youme meklie dobbubanoa eil blumakaui imen bumin bokise tem daak dofabiotabe. Niminbabe, nakaia unangai homoni Betlehem bib ye bianiba i niniino dola bianiba dait aalamin amo dinib kesoa i eil blumakaui am ota aala bianibta mene dobmikisobe.
Eil sibsib kimanin nakai weng sangobe.
Eka am olo dim ota eil sibsib kimanin nakai kwitimib sibsibi bib asak ye kima bliba
Sume abisake daak tenabea Sume ayale abilim ut danea bomat ge tubunea i isak daak dlakasea atemniba tosiansiba
abisake baabenea Ibo mo tosianimibe! Ne dowan weng ayamo baabenang genita daak tlibe. Nakaia unangai homoni weng olo wentaibo i seinomabiobo,
am olo dimo Debite bibo unang mako Sume Klaiste dofanobe. Klaiste mitmakamo Gode Dofakamin Nakabo, e nakaia unanga ibo hengmino temo blibo dotlanamabebe.
E biemo youme meklie dobbubanoa eil blumakaui imen bumin bokise tem daak dofanoa aambiebo, ibo moniba ne wengo baabei olo watemniba e wengo bainobo geine ge baabenabea
hebmamsab abisel homoni daak teniba abisake mak esu ye daake teniba i Gode niniino dobtouleb bianiba baaniba
Ni abilim ut bianoba Gode niniino kla dobtouleb nomabbiobo, eka dabalim olo naka mak unang maki Gode gobe biei bobol tem ayam omyebo gesiobe.
Eil sibsib kimanin nakai moniba Yesuse atemsiobe.
Abiseli inaniba deibeniba abilim uniba eil sibsib kimanin nakai baaniba Nibo monoba Betlehem bib unanoba Sume inamin namino baabene olo watemomo geniba
i hebmamsab moniba Betlehem bib unaniba Malia osa Yoseb esa yatemniba eka mene eil blumakaui imen bumin bokise tem daak biosa atemnasiobe.

I inaniba mene weng sango Gode abisake baabeneo omkayebiba Maliao weng olo wentenoa amitie fumbianoa bua eka i deibeniba moniba naka mak unang maki weng olo omkayebiba i wente bianiba bobol hekhek funiba

eil sibsib kimanin nakai deibeniba imin moniba eil sibsibi kima bianiba Gode weng olo abisake baabene osa eka i moniba Yesuse atem tlib osa fumbianiba Gode gangobo gabianiba e niniino dobtouleb monsiobe.
Simion esa Ana osa i weng sangobe.

Amo 8 blimanoa i Yesuse aalo watlabaniba e niniino Yesus ge nganabaniba sino awoko mo amunsaim blim bua abisake baabonea Ob miine dofanemebe e niniino Yesus ge nganabanale ge baabonebio kesoa o inanoa e niniino Yesus ge nganabanoa

Mosese hekmel wengo baanoa Unango memei dlano mole bua amo 40 blimanota o amun temo niniko klanoko! I hato moniba Gode am unaniba kulani dloniba Gode amo kimanin nakai doyiba Gode amo kimanin nakai yenaniba Gode dlaliba e i niniko omtlabeneko genobuo am olo tlo kesoa Yoseb esa Malia osa i Yesuse debetniba moniba Yelusalem bib unaniba Gode dabalomo geniba onsiobe.
Niminbabe, Gode buk temo baanoa Hek sume sin dofanomo debeb moniba Gode dabaline genoa eka

weng mak osa imin baanoa Ibo wan kubiamei ulabi asu yafu dleb moniba Gode amo kimanin nakai doyiba Gode amo kimanin nakai yenaniba Gode dlaliba Gode i niniko omtlabeneko genobua Yoseb esa Malia osa i weng olo fumbib kesoa i inanomo geniba Yesuse debetniba moniba Yelusalem bib ye temiba
naka make niniino Simione naka ayamobe. E Yelusalem bib ye binabebiotabe. E Gode wengo sbalma wafu bianea e Islel nakai bobol ayamo omyamabe nakae waisa bianea hembea Gode Hobe e bekeba bisebe.
Gode Hobe sino Simione baabanea Kobo kaanamabeb otane Gode Dofakamin Nakae Klaiste tlea atemnebta mitdata kaanamabeobo ge baabanebua
Gode Hobe debeb tamnea Gode am sum tam temnabea eka Yesuse aaleb kamwali Gode hekmel wengo olo baanobio inanomo geniba debeb teniba Gode am sumo tem tam temiba
Simione mene atemnea afu dobonea Gode niniino dobtouleb bianea baanea
Sum kobo sino keb wengo baatnenebbio memalo inaneba atemi kesoa ne bobolo ayam funania kaanamabibo,
kobo naka ele dofakanebbua ni hengmino temo biobo dotlanamabebe. Memalo tlea ne kino atemibe. Eka e sinanomo naka mak unang mak isa atemomabiobe.
E Yudabai ayal kesoa tubunea deib ayame alebenea atemniba Yudabai Islel ni niniino dotouleb nomabiobo ge baanea Simione mene weng sango
aaleb kamwali baabesea wenteniba bobol hekhek funsiba

e Gode baabanea I daabenale ge baabanea eka Maliao baabonea Gode men ele dofakanebuo Islel nakaia unangai mito baka bianiba maki e bainobo geniba sbal maniba eka mak ile e mo bainobo geim blim keniba watwat danomabib kesoa nakaia unangai homoni e weng dobo weng ohamomabiobe.
I inaniba i bobol tem funino keim anoa naka mak unang maki watemomabiobo, obsa bobolo ilum omfubkenamabobo gesea
eka Gode weng omkeimalin unang mako niniino Anao Gode am sumo tem ye bio o aalebe niniino Fanyuel etabe. O Asae molofeitobe. O imake omonea kam kebliba bifolo 7 blimanoa e kaane kesoa

deibanoa besa bua bifolo 84 blimanoa o konokanobiotabe. O amitie Gode am sumo tem tam bianoa kwinomosa tab dim osa o Gode bobolo fumbianoa imeno mo unalin blim besa bianoa beten kebianoa Gode niniino dobtouleb binabobua
am olo dimo tenoa Gode am sumo tem tamo Yesuse atemnoa Gode gangobo genoa Yelusalem bib seli i wasi nakai kweiban dimo Gode dotlanamabeo waisa hembib naka unangi men ele weng sango omkaye bisobe.
Yoseb esa e alel hatwal isa moniba Nasalet bib onsiobe.
Yoseb esa Malia osa i Gode hekmel wengo baanobio inaniba blimanoa i imin moniba ili bibo Galili betano Nasalet bib ye bliba
i miine damanea titilo omonea e bobol temo kla funanea Gode kima bia ayam bisebe.
Yesuse monea Gode am sumo tem tam onsebe.
Bifole elekiem elekieme Fasoba fal gamin dime amitie Yesuse aaleb kamwali moniba Yesusalem bib une binabib kesoa
Yesuse bifolo 12 blimanoa i imin inaniba Yesuse temnaniba moniba Yelusalem bibo
Fasoba falo dowoniba blimanoa nakaia unangai dli moniba ili bibam unebib otane Yesuse Yelusalem bib ye bia aaleb kamwali mo atemim blim keniba

i funaniba Nakaia unangai homoni dlibib kesoa naka mak ita bekebe natlamabebo geniba am olokiemo dimo deiba bebianiba hen heniba moniba aam biin ye waisa bianiba hembiba i nekwali alukum mo temib otane e mo baka tlim blim kesoa
i imin kam moniba Yelusalem bib unaniba mene hembiba
amo asumatnao blimanoa i taniba Gode am sumo tem tam temiba bia atemsiobe. E aleyemin nakai bekebe bia i wengo ohabiba wente bianea kil baabenemeo i yang kesib eka
isak e kil baabasiba yang kese bianiba e tekein kemino ayam kesoa e klayam yang kebea i atemniba smiko deibe unoa

eka e aaleb kamwal isa atemniba i smiko deibe unoa e biemo baabanoa Men kobo inabeba aye ni kamo hembianoba e ayam bie bleka misiam bieso gabianoba bobol ilum omkayebobo, nimin kenebta kobo inabebe? ge baabasoa
e awok kamwali baabenea Nimin kenibta ibo ne hembibe? Ne Aye am ele bli olole ibo mo tekein kebibbayo? gesea
awok kamwali e wengo mitmakamo klao mo tekein keim blim keniba
imin e temnaniba moniba ili bibo Nasalet bib ye bianiba awok kamwali wengo kla wente bianea inamin namino inanale genimibo klabea e biemo e kukub nabeo kla fumbisobe.
Yesuse ina bianea damanea e tekein kemino ayam anoa Gode kin dim osa nakaia unangai kin dim osa ayam ansebe.
